task.title: Keep build artifacts out of worker worktrees and make pending intents that need a health refresh get it while workers run

timeline_utc.16:00:11Z: Task RECON-CONSUMER-TIMEOUT-20261006 reopened; queue event registered.
timeline_utc.16:00:30Z: Worker workspace lease failed with skipped_dirty_worktree due to untracked pantheon_repo.egg-info/ and root /uv.lock created during test install.
timeline_utc.16:05:30Z: Claude provider delivery health observation reached TTL (300s) and expired.
timeline_utc.16:05:30Z-17:25:00Z: process_queue evaluated admission, saw expired delivery health, and set last_wait_reason to health_refresh_required, masking the underlying skipped_dirty_worktree blocker. Because other workers were running (live_total > 0), zero-worker refresh did not trigger. Pending queue intents (TASK_PENDING) were skipped by build_dispatch_plan, and queued_health_refresh_demand was placed after idle targets in supervisor_tick, starving Claude's endpoint from health refresh.
timeline_utc.17:25:00Z: Manual operator intervention executed supervisor.py --request-delivery-health-refresh, forcing health refresh and finally surfacing the skipped_dirty_worktree blocker.

root_causes: Untracked build artifacts (*.egg-info/ and /uv.lock) were not ignored by .gitignore, causing _classify_worktree_dirt to treat worktrees as dirty.
process_queue did not maintain separate last_blocking_reason tracking for non-refresh blockers when health_refresh_required was recorded, or hid current refresh state when preserving older blockers.

build_dispatch_plan only examined runnable/schedulable tasks and ignored pending intents, while probe_targets in supervisor_tick appended queued refresh demand after idle targets, starving pending intents of health probes when active workers ran.
changes: .gitignore: added *.egg-info/ and /uv.lock to prevent build artifacts from marking worker worktrees dirty.

.orchestrator/supervisor.py: in process_queue, always update last_wait_reason to most recent reason, store most recent non-refresh reason in last_blocking_reason (with timestamp), and clear both upon launch or requeue reset.
.orchestrator/supervisor.py: added queued_intent_health_refresh_targets() to demand delivery health refresh for unstarted non-terminal queue intents even when workers are active.

.orchestrator/supervisor.py: included queued_intent_health_refresh_targets in build_dispatch_plan, folded target loops while restoring explanatory comments, and prioritized queued_health_refresh_demand in probe_targets before idle targets.

.orchestrator/test_supervisor.py: added regression tests covering queued intent refresh while workers run, blocker preservation in last_blocking_reason with most recent reason in last_wait_reason, probe target prioritization, and worktree cleanliness with ignored build artifacts.

regression_tests.description: Verifies pending unstarted queue intents demand health refresh while active workers run without re-probing fresh endpoints.

Verifies process_queue always records most recent reason in last_wait_reason, preserves prior non-refresh blocker in last_blocking_reason (with timestamp), leaves last_wait_reason as health_refresh_required when blocker A is fixed, and clears both when started.
Verifies queued intent refresh targets are placed before idle targets in probe_targets to prevent probe starvation.
Verifies *.egg-info/ and /uv.lock are ignored by git and classified as clean by _classify_worktree_dirt.
